BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Taylor, Shea, Scott, Condotta, G. Hunt, Griffey, and Young
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Making licensed dealer delivery provisions consistent with federal law.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to making licensed dealer delivery provisions consistent with federal law; and amending RCW 9.41.092.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 9.41.092 and 2015 c 1 s 4 (Initiative Measure No. 594) are each amended to read as follows:Licensed dealer deliveries—Background checks.
BillSection.P: Except as otherwise provided in this chapter, a licensed dealer may not deliver any firearm to a purchaser or transferee until the earlier of:
(1) The results of all required background checks are known and the purchaser or transferee is not prohibited from owning or possessing a firearm under federal or state law; or

(2) TenThree business days have elapsed from the date the licensed dealer requested the background check. However, for sales and transfers of pistols if the purchaser or transferee does not have a valid permanent Washington driver's license or state identification card or has not been a resident of the state for the previous consecutive ninety days, then the time period in this subsection shall be extended from ten business days to sixty days.

AnnNote.NoteP: Finding—2015 c 1 (Initiative Measure No. 594): See note following RCW 9.41.010.
